goal.text: 20 demo calls booked with first-time founders this month

budget.basis: founder's ceiling for image plates this month

steps.brief: Reuse the shared context when it is recent; rebuild it only when it is missing or stale.
Collect what first-time founders say about demo calls, accelerators and fundraising help, to feed the copy of every later step.
Find 20 first-time founders with a dated public signal that they look for go-to-market help.
Audit the apply page against the demo call goal and list the fixes ranked by impact.

steps.label: demo-objections
steps.brief: One carousel that answers the objections founders raise before booking a call, built on the market-signal quotes.

inputs.topic: What a first call with an accelerator covers, answered with founders' own objections

steps.estimate_basis: local render, no image model planned

steps.label: demo-tofu
steps.brief: Four TOFU and MOFU ads on the escalated pains, rendered locally, packaged PAUSED for import.
steps.estimate_basis: founder's ceiling for photo plates in this batch, confirmed again at the agent's Gate 2

steps.brief: Dossiers and a three-step sequence for the people found, goal: book a call.

steps.label: demo-week
steps.brief: Queue the carousel on LinkedIn and X with the booking page as the link; schedule what the founder approves.

steps.label: pitch-talk
steps.brief: Three shorts from the founder's last talk, each ending on the booking page.

steps.label: demo-bofu
steps.brief: Two BOFU retargeting ads to apply page visitors, after the first batch.
steps.estimate_basis: founder's ceiling for two photo plates, confirmed again at the agent's Gate 2

steps.brief: Read the week, tie the numbers to what shipped (correlation only), and propose three experiments for the next sprint.
